context: This evaluation assesses how effectively the engineer uses eslint-plugin-react-compiler to build a monitoring system that tracks React compiler diagnostics, focusing on proper rule configuration, logger integration, and event handling specific to this package's API.

checklist.name: Plugin Configuration
checklist.description: Correctly imports and includes 'eslint-plugin-react-compiler' (or 'react-compiler' with the eslint-plugin- prefix omitted) in the ESLint plugins array

checklist.name: Rule Setup
checklist.description: Configures the 'react-compiler/react-compiler' rule in the ESLint rules section with appropriate options object

checklist.name: reportableLevels Configuration
checklist.description: Uses the 'reportableLevels' option with a Set containing ErrorSeverity enum values (e.g., ErrorSeverity.InvalidReact, ErrorSeverity.InvalidJS, ErrorSeverity.Todo) to control which error severities are reported

checklist.name: Logger Integration
checklist.description: Implements a custom logger object with a 'logEvent' method that accepts (filename, event) parameters and passes it to the rule via the 'logger' option

checklist.name: Event Handling
checklist.description: Correctly handles different LoggerEvent types (CompileSuccess, CompileError, CompileDiagnostic, PipelineError) by checking the event.kind property and extracting relevant data from each event type

checklist.name: Statistics Calculation
checklist.description: Aggregates compilation statistics from captured events, such as counting successful compilations vs errors, and optionally extracting memoization metrics (memoSlots, memoBlocks, memoValues) from CompileSuccess events
